_fixture_note: Reconstructed in fetch_fishing.py's shape from the readings the 2026-08-25 Times and Sports & Sportsman editions printed, so the byte-match gate has a file to trace them to. A test fixture, not a hydrological record: only the values the papers quoted are carried.

ohio.note: 14 miles above R.C. Byrd Locks and Dam — the pool side
ohio.read: 24.9 ft - normal pool. Ordinary bank access.

ohio.note: below R.C. Byrd Locks and Dam
ohio.read: 27.3 ft and falling - up and pushing. Expect colour and current; fish the slack behind anything solid.

tides.note: inside the ICWW/Topsail Sound, about on par with where the crew fishes two nautical miles north of New Topsail Inlet

topsail.read: Fish the moving water either side of high at 6:39 AM and 7:16 PM in the sound.
